title: Paramārthasāra — Essence of the Ultimate
author: Abhinavagupta
text:
The Paramārthasāra is Abhinavagupta's hundred-verse digest of the whole Trika doctrine, composed in tenth-century Kashmir and arranged for recitation in daily portions. It opens with a student, whirled in the wheel of sorrow, asking the Blessed Lord the supreme truth — and the Lord answers across the remaining verses: refuge in Śambhu, the all-aboding, beginningless, one and manifold; then the structure of reality, knowledge, bondage and release, set down with the economy of a master who has already said it at length in the Tantrāloka and now wants it memorizable.

Its juice: this is the essence (sāra) by design — the entire system in a form a student can hold. Its juice is compression without loss: each verse is a doorway into an argument the tradition spent volumes building, and the work remains the standard first text for entering non-dual Kashmir Shaivism.
